title: 第1389章 终于动手了玄武老龟出手第1388章 星辰空间天戈主人
slug: 五灵根修炼慢我有百倍灵药空间
content_zh:
第1389章终于动手了，玄武老龟出手
陆青禾这些年售卖了大多数资源，却留下不少阵道好材料。
现在将这些材料全部拿出来，足以炼制一座大阵。
他有炼制封天旗和三十六天雷大阵的能力，更是炼制出道器，炼制皇级大阵难度不是很大，只是需要耗费不少时间。
在陆青禾炼制阵法的这段时间。
随着紫天一一直没有出现，天虚传送大阵再也没有开启，天虚仙城更是混乱。
这天，五尊修士破空而来，落在了陆家地界上空。
玄尘一身黑袍出现在虚空上空，冷漠的看着五人：“诸位道友，你们来错地方了，这里是陆家。”
带头的炼虚后期修士阴恻恻地说道：“老不死的，你最好滚得远远的，本座几人今日不是来找你的，而是那两个女人。”
“让她们交出丹药和灵脉，我等可以饶她们性命。”
玄尘大怒：“就你们这些土鸡瓦狗，也敢对陆家动手，真的是活腻了。”
玄尘身上恐怖的气息爆发出来，身上神通照耀了整个虚空。
五尊修士脸色一变：“炼虚八重天。”
“三人拖住这老不死的，其他人进入陆家抓住两女。”
三道身影将玄尘围住，一道道法则神通撕裂了陆家上空。
两道身影撕破虚空，想要进入陆家之中。
“吼！”
一声怒吼，两个炼虚后期修士重创倒飞了出来。
等抬眼看去，一只遮天蔽日的老龟出现在仙城上空，恐怖的威压笼罩整个天虚仙城。
无数修士震惊的看着天上的老龟。

“绝世妖皇出世了？”
“是陆家，有人忍不住对陆家出手了。”
“五尊炼虚后期修士出手，真的好算计。”
“只是这妖皇至少是炼虚九重天，那老者是炼虚八重天，想不到陆家竟然掩藏这样恐怖的实力。”
“不知道五尊炼虚后期修士能不能吃下陆家资源。”
“不可能，那是玄武老龟，防御惊人，炼虚大圆满来了都打不破他的防御，他们要倒霉了。”
无数法则落在，在玄武老龟上炸开火花，根本伤不到玄武老龟。
玄武老龟庞大的气息更是压在虚空之上，让几尊修士的法则受到了极大的压制。
老龟吐出神雷，一击洞穿虚空，将一尊修士击落虚空。
带头的修士看到如此恐怖的玄武巨龟，脸色惊骇：“撤！”
五人撕裂虚空，想要撤走。
这个时候一道冷漠的声音响了起来：“这里是你们想来就来，想走就走的地方吗？”
林傲霜和月无瑕的身影出现在虚空之上。
林傲霜摇动铃铛，恐怖的摄魂法则笼罩虚空，几人呆立虚空，等挣脱摄魂铃的束缚时。
玄武老龟的爪子已经到了他们的身前，一把将他们直接抓碎，元神想要逃离。
天欲儿早已经等候多时，出现在虚空之上，将元神抓在手中。
瞬间，在玄武巨龟和摄魂铃的配合之下，五尊炼虚七重天修士殒命当场。
这震惊了整个天虚仙城的修士，他们不敢置信。
“五尊炼虚大修士就这样陨落了。”
“这神秘的陆家不好惹。”

“原本还想算计他们的资源，现在看来是一块难啃的骨头。”
无数神识交织，最后归于平静。
content_en:
Chapter 1389 Finally took action, Xuanwu Old Turtle took action
Lu Qinghe has sold most of the resources over the years, but left behind a lot of good formation materials.
Now taking out all these materials is enough to refine a large formation.
He has the ability to refine the Sealing Heaven Banner and the Thirty-Six Heavenly Thunder Formation, and even refine Taoist tools. Refining the Imperial Level Formation is not very difficult, but it does take a lot of time.
During the time when Lu Qinghe was refining the formation.
As Zi Tianyi never appeared, the Tianxu Teleportation Formation was never opened again, and Tianxu Fairy City was even more chaotic.
On this day, five monks came out of the sky and landed above the Lu family's boundary.
Xuan Chen appeared in the sky in a black robe and looked at the five people indifferently: "Fellow Taoists, you have come to the wrong place. This is the Lu family."
The leading cultivator in the late stage of the Void Refinement said in a sinister tone: "Old immortal, you'd better get away. I'm not here to find you today, but those two women."
"Ask them to hand over the elixirs and spiritual veins, and we can spare their lives."
Xuan Chen was furious: "You idiots like you dare to attack the Lu family. I'm really tired of living."
The terrifying aura on Xuan Chen's body burst out, and his magical power illuminated the entire void.
The expressions of the five monks changed: "Eighth Heaven of Refining the Void."
"The three of them dragged the old man away while the others entered the Lu house and grabbed the two girls."
Three figures surrounded Xuan Chen, and magical powers tore through the sky above the Lu family.
Two figures tore through the void, trying to enter the Lu family.
"Roar!"
With a roar, the two monks in the late stage of Void Refining were severely injured and flew out.
When he looked up, an old turtle that covered the sky and sun appeared in the sky above the fairy city, and a terrifying pressure enveloped the entire Tianxu fairy city.
Countless monks looked at the old turtle in the sky in shock.
"The peerless demon emperor is born?"
"It's the Lu family. Someone couldn't help but take action against the Lu family."
"It's really easy for the five monks in the late stage of Void Refining to take action."
"It's just that the Demon King is at least the ninth level of Xu Refining, and the old man is at the eighth level of Xu Refining. I didn't expect that the Lu family could hide such terrifying strength."
"I wonder if the five monks in the late stage of cultivating the void can take advantage of the Lu family's resources."
"Impossible, that's the old Xuanwu Turtle. His defense is amazing. Even the Great Perfection of Refining the Void can't break through his defense. They will be in trouble."
Countless laws fell on Xuanwu Old Turtle and exploded with sparks, unable to hurt Xuanwu Old Turtle at all.
The huge aura of the Xuanwu Old Turtle pressed against the void, greatly suppressing the laws of several monks.
The old turtle spit out divine thunder, penetrated the void with one blow, and knocked down a monk into the void.
The leading monk looked horrified when he saw such a terrifying giant basalt turtle: "Get out!"
The five people tore through the void and wanted to retreat.
At this time, a cold voice sounded: "Is this a place where you can come and leave whenever you want?"
The figures of Lin Aoshuang and Yue Wuxia appeared in the void.
Lin Aoshuang shook the bell, and the terrifying Soul-Capturing Law shrouded the void. Several people stood stunned in the void, waiting to break free from the shackles of the Soul-Capturing Bell.
The claws of the old Xuanwu turtle had already reached in front of them and scratched them to pieces. The soul wanted to escape.
Tian Yu'er had been waiting for a long time and appeared in the void, grabbing the soul in his hands.
In an instant, with the cooperation of the Black Tortoise and the Soul-Calling Bell, the five seventh-level Void Refining monks died on the spot.
This shocked the entire Tianxu Immortal City monks, they couldn't believe it.
"The five great monks of Void Refining have fallen like this."
"This mysterious Lu family is not easy to mess with."
"Originally I wanted to take advantage of their resources, but now it seems that it is a hard nut to crack."
Countless consciousnesses intertwined and finally returned to peace.
